headline.purpose: One page title per screen, can carry actions inline.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a form or dialog exists for.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; padding: .4rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1c1917); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #b45309); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent, #b45309); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; padding: .4rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1c1917); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation, e.g. overwrite restore or delete.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; padding: .4rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--danger, #b91c1c); color: #fff; border-color: var(--danger, #b91c1c); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--danger, #b91c1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Stacked label above a recessed rice-paper field.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: .25rem; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--fg, #1c1917); } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 15px; padding: .4rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg, #fafaf9); color: var(--fg, #1c1917); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b45309); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top bar: brand, sections, user and log out.
components.html: 🥟 DumplingBackupsPlansOperationsadmin
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; padding: .75rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); background: var(--card, #fff); flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: 1rem; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--fg, #1c1917); text-decoration: none; padding: .25rem 0; } .ds-nav a.active { color: var(--accent, #b45309); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #b45309); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent, #b45309); } .ds-spacer { flex: 1; } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #78716c); }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Outline pills, color fixed by outcome.
components.html: success skipped failed running
components.css: .ds-status { font-size: .8rem; padding: .1rem .45rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ok { color: var(--ok, #15803d); } .ds-warn { color: var(--warn, #a16207); } .ds-fail { color: var(--danger, #b91c1c); } .ds-run { color: var(--accent, #b45309); }

components.name: Tray
components.description: Flat bordered white tray; forms share it.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; display: grid; gap: .75rem; color: var(--fg, #1c1917); } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #78716c); }

components.name: Warning Banner
components.html: MyISAM tables are not dumped consistently.
components.css: .ds-warn-banner { color: var(--warn, #a16207); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn, #a16207) 10%, transparent); padding: .5rem .75rem; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Operation Log
components.description: Always-dark terminal panel for live operation output.
components.html:
pg_dump: dumping contents of table public.orders

backup finished in 12.4s
components.css: .ds-log { background: #0c0a09; color: #e7e5e4; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; overflow: auto; max-height: 60vh; font-size: .85rem; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Dumpling is a stack of plain trays. Every surface is a flat white tray on warm rice paper, edged by a thin stone line, holding exactly what it says it holds: a table of backups, a form, a log. Nothing is hidden under decoration, and nothing floats. The one warm note is the amber of a pan-fried wrapper, reserved for the action you came to take and for where you are.

The system is deliberately small: one stylesheet (`web/src/styles.css`), nine color tokens, the platform's own font, and a handful of utility classes. Density is that of an operator's tool, compact tables and forms at a 15px base, readable on a weekly check-in and calm during a restore. Status lives in color-coded outline pills; failures are red and plain, never softened.

Dark mode follows the OS (`prefers-color-scheme`) and flips the trays to warm charcoal while the amber brightens. The live operation log is always a dark terminal, in both themes.
keyCharacteristics: Flat trays on warm paper; 1px stone borders carry all structure.
Single accent (amber) for primary action, active nav, links and running states.
System font stack only; no web fonts.
Outline status pills color-coded by outcome.
Native elements styled lightly (`<dialog>`, `<table>`, form controls), not replaced.

rules.name: The One Warm Note Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent. It marks the primary action, the current location and work in progress; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Outcome Color Rule
rules.body: Red, green and mustard mean failed, succeeded and needs attention. Never use them for anything else.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: No web fonts. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and Steam Grey, not from a second family.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Trays sit flat. If something needs to stand apart, give it a border or a tonal step, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep everything in `web/src/styles.css` with tokens as `:root` custom properties; add a dark value in the `prefers-color-scheme` block for any new neutral.
Do build screens from the existing trays, tables, stacked labels and `.row` grid before inventing a layout.
Do use the native `<dialog>` for confirmations, with a Danger button for destructive ones.
Do show outcomes with the status pill vocabulary and its fixed color mapping.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or a second accent color (The No-Lift and One Warm Note rules).
Don't load web fonts or an icon font; the 🥟 emoji is the only mark.
Don't use red, green or mustard decoratively.
Don't add a UI component library; the plain CSS approach is part of the single-binary constraint.
